resources.string: Battery, power, AC state and both temperatures at a glance, on a card that fills with the charge. Read-only; refreshes every 15 min while the phone is on van-core Wi-Fi.
Join the van-core network. Mobile data can stay on — this app uses the Wi-Fi only for the van.
The Wi-Fi is connected, but the node did not reply. Retrying automatically.
Wi-Fi to van-core lost — values are frozen. Reconnecting…
Build %1$d is ready; this is build %2$d. About %3$s MB over your internet connection (mobile data in the van). van-core closes while it installs; open it again afterwards.
To install its own updates, van-core needs Android\'s permission to install apps. Turn on \"Allow from this source\", then come back to van-core.
Installing. van-core will close; open it again in a moment.
Asking GitHub for a newer build…
Not while van-core is being flashed: installing closes the app and would cut the upload off.
This is build %1$d, the newest on GitHub.
This is build %1$d, newer than the newest on GitHub (build %2$d).
Couldn\'t reach GitHub. The check needs mobile data or a Wi-Fi with internet; the van Wi-Fi has none.
Reading the image and asking van-core whether AC is on…
This image calls itself \"%1$s\". Flashing it replaces van-core, and with it the fridge control, until van-core is flashed back.
AC is ON. Good: if the new firmware does not start, the station keeps the fridge powered.
AC is OFF. If the new firmware does not start, the fridge stays off until someone presses the P310\'s own AC button. Turn AC on first (kitchen button), then flash.
AC state unknown: van-core did not say. Flash with AC on, so that a firmware that does not start leaves the fridge powered.
About a minute over the van Wi-Fi. van-core restarts at the end; keep this screen open until it is back.
Not connected to the van-core Wi-Fi.
Cancelled. van-core keeps the firmware it had.
The image is in. Waiting for van-core to come back…
The link dropped after the whole image was sent, so van-core may be restarting with it. Waiting to see…

Running: %1$s
Image sent: built %2$s

If the running build is not the one you sent, van-core rolled back to its previous firmware.
It is answering again. The image sent was built %1$s; Diag shows the version it runs.

Nothing from van-core for %1$d s. Check the phone has rejoined the van Wi-Fi. If the node stays away, its safe mode still accepts a flash. If AC was off, the fridge stays off until the P310\'s own AC button is pressed.
